original_ask: Pick the queue technology for the billing pipeline.
intent_brief: Choose a queue for billing events: reliable, cheap to run, easy to operate.

loops.eli5: Seven experts suggested queues; we kept the five most reliable and cheap.

L1: Managed cloud queue with dead-letter topic and SLA.
Zero-ops serverless queue billing strictly per request.
Built-in priority lanes for urgent invoice retries.
Schema registry enforced before publishing billing events.
One-click replay from dead-letter to main topic.
Multi-region active-passive queue replication for disaster recovery.
Per-tenant fair queueing to prevent noisy neighbors.
Native batch consumer trigger reducing worker wakeups.
Retention window of fourteen days for audit replay.
Automatic backoff policy configured at queue level.
Pre-built Terraform module for zero manual provisioning.
Simple web console for support team inspection.
L2: Transactional outbox table polling inside existing Postgres.
Idempotency key unique index preventing double-billing.
Deterministic state machine transitions recorded in ledger.
Fencing tokens on consumer leases to stop stale writes.
End-to-end checksums validated at producer and consumer.
Dead-letter alerts with exact failing payload snapshot.
Strict FIFO ordering partitioned by customer account ID.
Chaos tests injecting duplicate and out-of-order deliveries.
Verify consumer commit only after ledger write succeeds.
Sequence numbers per invoice detecting dropped events early.
Two-phase reservation before dispatching external charge.
Automated reconciliation cron comparing ledger against queue.
Contract tests locking billing event JSON schema.
L3: Single Postgres SKIP LOCKED worker queue, zero new infra.
Drop message broker completely; run synchronous charge calls.
Thin Python consumer loop using standard library HTTP.
Embed queue abstraction behind five-line interface.
Avoid Kafka cluster until throughput exceeds ten thousand RPS.
Use SQLite WAL local buffer only if cloud fails.
Single monorepo package shared by producer and worker.
Fixed retry count of three before manual review.
Stateless worker binary with zero local disk state.
No custom serialization; plain UTF-8 JSON payloads.
Skip schema registry; validate with Pydantic on edge.
Run workers as existing ECS service containers.
Plain cron sweeper replacing complex delayed-queue timers.
L4: Batch ten billing events per SQS send call.
Long-polling consumers cutting empty receive requests ninety percent.
Compress payloads over four kilobytes with zstd.
Spot-instance autoscaling workers driven by queue depth.
Tiered storage offloading payloads over 64KB to S3.
Partition hot merchants across dedicated shard keys.
Connection pooling in workers to avoid DB exhaustion.
Benchmark p99 enqueue-to-ledger latency under peak billing.
Cap max inflight messages per worker to bound RAM.
Pre-warm consumer pools before monthly billing run.
Deduplicate identical webhook retries at ingress cache.
Measure dollar cost per million settled invoices.
Adaptive prefetch count tuned to database commit time.
L5: Separate dead-letter queue for malformed poison messages.
Encrypt sensitive PII fields inside payload before enqueue.
Least-privilege IAM role splitting producer and consumer rights.
Circuit breaker pausing consumers when gateway errors spike.
Rate-limit retries to protect downstream payment processor.
Alert immediately on queue age exceeding five minutes.
Sign event payloads with HMAC to block tampering.
Audit trail logging every manual message redrive.
Strip raw card tokens; pass vault references only.
Quarantine single failing tenant without stalling others.
Fail closed if idempotency store becomes unreachable.
Timeout visibility leases shorter than gateway SLA.
Redact secrets from structured error logs automatically.
L6: Skip queues; compute monthly bills via batch DuckDB.
Use Temporal workflows instead of raw message queues.
Append-only object storage log replacing broker altogether.
Let payment provider webhooks drive billing state directly.
Use NATS JetStream single binary across three nodes.
Replace async billing with prepaid credit drawdown.
Run DuckLake nightly settlement instead of streaming.
Use Redis Streams with AOF persistence for speed.
Turn billing into materialized Postgres view triggers.
Outsource metered aggregation and queueing to Stripe.
Combine Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY with periodic sweep fallback.
Use Cloudflare Queues at edge near API ingress.
Keep queue ephemeral; rebuild state from event store.
L7: OpenTelemetry trace context propagated inside message headers.
Structured Prometheus gauges for lag and DLQ depth.
Runbook documenting exact steps to drain and replay.
Blue-green consumer deployment draining inflight messages first.
Synthetic canary invoice pushed every five minutes.
Automated Terraform drift checks in CI pipeline.
PagerDuty escalation routed directly to billing on-call.
CLI tool to inspect, skip, or replay messages.
Zero-downtime schema evolution using additive fields only.
Load-shedding flag to pause non-urgent receipt emails.
Dashboard pairing queue lag with bank settlement lag.
Weekly automated backup test of dead-letter archives.
Graceful SIGTERM shutdown finishing active batch before exit.

candidates.body: Managed queue with dead-letter topic and idempotent consumers.
candidates.eli5: A post office that never loses letters.

retro: Lesson proposed: always include idempotency in billing designs.
